{"candidate_rtl":"module crc32_d8(input wire [7:0] data_in, input wire [31:0] state_in, output wire [7:0] data_out, output wire [31:0] state_out);
function [31:0] crc_step;
    input [31:0] state;
    input data_bit;
    reg feedback;
    integer i;
    begin
        feedback = state[31] ^ data_bit;
        crc_step[0] = feedback;
        for (i = 1; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
            if ((32'h04c11db7 >> i) & 1)
                crc_step[i] = state[i-1] ^ feedback;
            else
                crc_step[i] = state[i-1];
        end
    end
endfunction
wire [31:0] s0 = {state_in[0],state_in[1],state_in[2],state_in[3],state_in[4],state_in[5],state_in[6],state_in[7],state_in[8],state_in[9],state_in[10],state_in[11],state_in[12],state_in[13],state_in[14],state_in[15],state_in[16],state_in[17],state_in[18],state_in[19],state_in[20],state_in[21],state_in[22],state_in[23],state_in[24],state_in[25],state_in[26],state_in[27],state_in[28],state_in[29],state_in[30],state_in[31]};

endmodule","bottleneck":"The original implementation creates 40 wide parity cones from generated masks. The optimized form exposes the reflected Galois recurrence directly, with eight compact constant-tap stages and direct shifted-out data bits.","rewrite":"Replaced mask generation and wide reductions with an explicitly unrolled eight-bit reflected CRC recurrence. State and data bit reversal required by REVERSE=1 are represented at the input and output boundaries.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected lower maximum data arrival from reduced fan-in per stage, simplified constant tap logic, and direct data_out paths. The eight recurrence stages preserve the exact combinational latency contract.","area_or_other_cost":"Expected area reduction from eliminating generated mask networks and redundant wide parity logic. The implementation uses 256 constant tap decisions and eight 32-bit intermediate buses.","functional_boundaries":"Exact for all 40 input bits. It implements GALOIS, polynomial 32'h04c11db7, DATA_WIDTH=8, REVERSE=1, feed-forward disabled, including arbitrary state_in and exact data_out behavior."}
